nodes.desc: Initial IVERI baseline with enabled gradient checkpointing and static MoR.
Disabled gradient checkpointing for short context (+41.7% throughput).
Added recursive gradient norm clipping within MoR layers.
Adaptive MoR depth scheduling (depth=0 for seq_len < 128).
Fully integrated and statistically validated IVERI architecture.

edges.reason: Profiling evidence showed 41.7% checkpointing overhead at short seq_len
Failure analysis traced explosions to MoR recursive accumulation
Ablations proved No-MoR gives 2x throughput at short context without loss penalty
